message.content:
The cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large red letters features an illustration of a man sitting in a large, red leather-tufted armchair. The man has short black hair, wears a light blue button-down shirt, tan trousers, and black shoes. He is reclining with his hands behind his head and his eyes closed, with one leg crossed over the other. The chair is positioned centrally, and a disembodied hand holding a hand-saw is visible on the right, sawing through one of the wooden front legs of the armchair.

The background is plain white. At the top, text reads "Label Halal Jajanan Haram H.68" and "QRIS dalam Tekanan Trump H.80". Large black text on the left states "ORKES PEMAKZULAN GIBRAN" followed by a paragraph of smaller text. In the bottom right corner, smaller text includes the date "5-11 MEI 2025," a price of "RP 60.000," website information, an ISSN number, a barcode, and a QR code. A red "53" logo is next to the "TEMPO" masthead.
